Citymaker.Palette.Tooltip: The stones the ground is laid in, chosen together: main paving, border band, focal pad, walks and inlay accents. Automatic uses the palette this style is designed with. Pick a surface for one role below to make your own mix.
Citymaker.Palette.auto.Detail: The palette this style is designed with: calm stone unless the preset says otherwise.
Citymaker.Palette.classic.Detail: Pale granite slabs · slate border · grey fan-set rondel · herringbone walks
Citymaker.Palette.sandstone.Detail: Smooth sandstone · warm grey paver border · pale flagstone rondel
Citymaker.Palette.brickStone.Detail: Muted brick herringbone · granite sett border · grey fan-set rondel
Citymaker.Palette.modern.Detail: Large concrete slabs · black granite band · polished concrete pad
Citymaker.Palette.terracotta.Detail: Ochre slabs · orange brick bands · pale stone rondel
Citymaker.Palette.cobble.Detail: Granite setts · slate flag border · cobble-fan rondel · flagstone walks
Citymaker.Palette.garden.Detail: Soft grey-brown brick · warm sett border · pale flagstone pads
Citymaker.Palette.custom.Detail: Your own surfaces: the roles you picked below replace the palette's stones, the rest stay Automatic.
Citymaker.Palette.Role.borderSurface.Too: The band that frames the paving along the outline (and the ring round the focal pad). Automatic = from the palette.
Citymaker.Palette.Role.focalSurface.Tool: The round pad under and around the fountain or statue. Automatic = from the palette.
Citymaker.Palette.Role.pathSurface.Toolt: Walks laid from the entrances to the middle on bigger squares. Automatic = from the palette.
Citymaker.Palette.Role.inlaySurface.Tool: Thin dark accents: inlay lines, tree pits, an outer ring. Automatic = from the palette.
